title: The effect of surface ligands on the surface chemical states and photoluminescence characteristics in cesium lead bromide perovskite nanocrystals
content:

This paper presents the results of our study on the relationship between the surface chemical states, which are influenced by ligands, and photoluminescence (PL) characteristics in cesium lead halide perovskite nanocrystals (NCs).
